_comment: OpenClaw automations for PandaBase. OpenClaw stores jobs in its SQLite state DB, so this file is documentation + input for `make install-agent-cron` (M8): each entry becomes `openclaw automations add --name <name> --cron <cron> --tz <tz> --session isolated --message <message> --tools exec,read,write,message,browser --no-deliver`. Skills post to Discord themselves with the message tool, so run output isn't announced. Entries with `command` are command payloads (no model call) announced to the named channel instead. Times are household-local (tz).

jobs.name: pandabase-saturday-build
jobs.message: Use $grocery-cycle: run the Saturday cart build.

jobs.name: pandabase-monday-open
jobs.message: Use $grocery-cycle: ensure a cycle is open (Monday fallback).

jobs.name: pandabase-receipts-will
jobs.message: Use $digital-receipt-scraper: sweep receipts for member will.

jobs.name: pandabase-receipts-partner
jobs.message: Use $digital-receipt-scraper: sweep receipts for member partner.

jobs.name: pandabase-job-replies
jobs._comment: Command payload: no model turn. `openclaw automations add --name pandabase-job-replies --cron '*/5 * * * *' --tz America/Los_Angeles --command 'pandabase-tools jobs replies' --command-env PANDABASE_CONFIG=... --announce --channel discord --to channel:<intake_channel>`. Prints NO_REPLY when there is nothing to say.
